headline: CONDENAN A 12 años a expresidente JAMIL MAHAUD
content: ECUADOR (EFE) La Corte Nacional de Justicia de Ecuador condenó en ausencia a 12 años de prisión al expresidente Jamil Mahaud como autor del delito de peculado por la crisis financiera de 1999. La sentencia se dio pocos días después de que la Interpol emitiera una orden internacional de detención. En octubre de 1998, Mahud y el expresidente Alberto Fujimori suscribieron un acuerdo definitivo de límites.

headline: RUSSIA. MINISTER OF FOREIGN AFFAIRS EMPHASIZES THAT ISSUES MUST BE RESOLVED WITHOUT FOREIGN INTERVENTION
content: Moscow approaches Venezuela and rejects US sanctions. Minister Sergey Lavrov expressed his support for Venezuelan efforts to promote dialogue with opposition groups. MOSCOU (AFP): Russia opposes any interference in its internal affairs and measures such as imposing sanctions. This refers to the resolution adopted Wednesday by the House of Representatives of Congress which approved legislation implementing sanctions against officials responsible for violations of human rights within the Chavez regime. We proceed from the principle that all issues should be resolved based constitutionally without external intervention, declared Lavrov during a conference held in Moscow attended also by his colleague from Venezuela, Elias Jaua, whom he conveyed Russian solidarity towards their governments position regarding Nicolas Maduro’s attempts to overcome difficulties in establishing dialogues.

headline: MATAN A 35 personas GUERRA TOTAL CONTRA GRUPO BOKO HARÁM
content: LAGOS (EFE)--The President of Nigeria, Goodluck Jonathan promised rescue operations for the remaining students who were kidnapped while announcing large-scale military action aimed at ending terrorist impunity associated with the Islamist group Boko Haram, known for numerous attacks across northern regions. Specifically yesterday, armed men killed thirty-five people in three villages located in Borno State attributed to actions carried out by said Islamic extremist organization.

headline: COMO DESTROY A PARTY
content: Subnational elections put political party cohesion to the test through candidate selection processes and coalition negotiations causing tensions between leadership factions and emerging forces. These strains indicate organizational vitality but could lead to prolonged decline if dominated by overly personalized sectors. Such seems to occur with Possible Party (PP), unlike other organizations experiencing institutionalization setbacks due to recent controversies involving key figures like José Lenin, despite claims otherwise. Its weaknesses lie primarily in failing to establish a recognizable ideological identity oscillating ambiguously between left-wing and centrist positions amidst declining influence following scandals linked closely to nationalistic alliances.

headline: LAS DECLARACIONES DE LA EXPRESIDENTA DE DEVIDA SOBRE SU SALIDA DEL CARGO

headline: CESAR LVAREZ Y OTROS 28 SON ACUSADOS POR LA FISCALA DE HOMICIDIO CALIFICADO

headline: ‘No se ha priorizado el gasto’
content: En una institución en que los ingresos superan a los egresos no puede haber falta de presupuesto para cosas que son consideradas partes normales de cada dependencia. Lo que pasa es que esta gestión no ha priorizado bien los gastos y se ha preferido invertir en cosas que son políticamente correctas, como es el caso del programa Barrio Mío. Demoraron mucho en asignar el dinero a los entes que lo necesitan para su trabajo cotidiano. ¿Qué se debe hacer ahora?, queda claro que nunca será tarde, porque esta administración ya prácticamente está de salida. Sin embargo, algunas medidas podrían implementarse, tales como asignar recursos extraordinarios además de reordenar el presupuesto y atender lo más urgente.
